title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and maintain mask-wearing behavior over time under social influence, policy mandates, messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update mask attitude and risk perception based on observed behaviors and attitudes of social neighbors.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask mandates, affecting compliance and costs for non-compliance.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from the market subject to supply, price, and personal income.

interactions.name: public_messaging
interactions.description: Authorities and media broadcast messages that influence individuals' risk perception and trust.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contacts
interactions.description: Individuals move between locations (home, work, public spaces), creating opportunities to observe mask usage and face enforcement.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches or exceeds 70%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed mask-wearing proportion over the simulation.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_days
metrics.description: Number of consecutive days adoption remains above a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across demographic groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index by income or age).

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Share of visits to mandated locations where individuals are compliant with mask rules.

metrics.name: mask_purchase_rate
metrics.description: Rate of mask purchases per capita per day.

metrics.name: supply_stockouts_days
metrics.description: Number of days with market inventory at zero.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds_check
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rates must remain within [0,1] for all time steps.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_check
validation_criteria.description: Adoption time series is considered converged if the moving average change over a 14-day window is below 0.5 percentage points.

validation_criteria.name: supply_demand_balance_sanity
validation_criteria.description: Total masks sold cannot exceed cumulative supply plus initial inventory; stockouts occur only when inventory is zero.
